device: iPhone Duo Simulator (shared persistent Duo 94D56458-B90B-484A-BA5E-16748D2CBEE5), closed, portrait
notes: Runtime captures, not renders, on ticket/135-evening-summary based on spec/124-habit-loop with #131 merged. Choices are set through the fixture (no tap access from the agent); the Delivery binding is covered by NotificationsScreenTests.theDeliveryChoiceIsSavedAndReachesTheRelay. No before capture at this scroll position: before this branch nothing could scroll the screen to its end, and Delivery is new (the section sat between About you and Quiet hours as a comment). The app has one (dark) appearance, so light/dark isn't separate. The summary tap feeds a summary response through the notification delegate's own route (-ScreenshotNotificationResponse with -ScreenshotNotificationKind summary); no notification was shown, since relay alert pushes can't reach the Simulator without a real APNs token. The summary's copy and timing are pinned by relay/test/eveningSummary.test.ts. The open iPhone Duo and accessibility text sizes were not captured.
